shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall upright slab/pillar
anthropomorphic figure(s) with arms and hands rendered
horizontal band of repeated small motifs acting as a register divider
row of repeated elements along the top edge
figures with prominent eyes/heads shown in profile or frontal schematic form
stacked registers of imagery filling the whole surface
justification: Both are tall upright slabs covered edge-to-edge in shallow low relief, divided into stacked registers by a horizontal band of repeated small marks, with schematic profile animals and anthropomorphic elements in the fields; that general compositional habit is the strongest correspondence. But the depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows elaborate costumed human figures with headdresses, glyph-like blocks and dense curvilinear ornament stacked vertically, while B shows a row of crouching quadrupeds along the top and isolated animals (long-necked bird, small quadruped, feline-like creature) scattered in open ground with no human costume, ornament or sign blocks.
